findings.raw_evidence: candidate rows carry class-associated observed_* keys
findings.required_correction: replace class-associated keys with role-specific neutral records
findings.risk: terminal class is encoded in the measurement contract

findings.raw_evidence: expanded_receipts = (receipts * 2)[:4] and signal is printed
findings.required_correction: materialize candidate-specific probes from independent role receipts
findings.risk: duplicated old receipts become answer-bearing probes

findings.raw_evidence: signals maps observed_* keys directly to terminal families
findings.required_correction: derive semantic facts through registered verifiers and causal-board constraints
findings.risk: probe output directly selects the terminal

findings.raw_evidence: post_repair_results and duplicate_postpatch_full_target_result are decision inputs
findings.required_correction: exclude post-repair, validation, fixed, gold, and future records
findings.risk: future outcome evidence contaminates diagnosis

findings.raw_evidence: two receipt objects are reused for five semantic roles
findings.required_correction: require one independently verified receipt per role or an equivalence proof
findings.risk: role identity is asserted rather than measured

findings.raw_evidence: eligibility checks 64-character hashes and literal booleans
findings.required_correction: verify receipt producer, role, source, timing, and custody
findings.risk: syntactic receipt shape is treated as semantic provenance

findings.raw_evidence: frame_hash excludes the probes key
findings.required_correction: bind probe contracts and plans into the frozen frame hash
findings.risk: probe definitions can change without changing the decision frame

findings.raw_evidence: blind runtime owns the terminal while canonical DPP-14 output is ignored
findings.required_correction: make causal_board and probe_planner own terminal production
findings.risk: the canonical causal-board path is bypassed

findings.raw_evidence: canonical probes execute print('receipt_probe_executed=true')
findings.required_correction: execute candidate-specific registered probes and consume their terminal
findings.risk: synthetic compatibility traces do not measure the candidate

findings.raw_evidence: set-intersection updates cannot add a family outside the prior frontier
findings.required_correction: route conflicting verified facts through truth maintenance and branch ledger
findings.risk: contradiction and backtracking are unreachable

findings.raw_evidence: the observed macro score is copied into fixed, random, no-memory, and historical rows
findings.required_correction: execute each preregistered baseline under equal budget
findings.risk: baselines are labels rather than executions

findings.raw_evidence: every non-source truth row is included in safe-abstention accuracy
findings.required_correction: scope abstention accuracy only to preregistered abstention truth cases
findings.risk: positive ownership classes are mis-scored as abstentions

findings.raw_evidence: wrong_patch_authorizations and label_leakage_count are literal zero
findings.required_correction: reconstruct authorization from token ledgers and leakage from complete inputs/code/logs
findings.risk: safety metrics are asserted instead of reconstructed

findings.raw_evidence: requirements are looped into named producer/verifier rows using a small receipt pool
findings.required_correction: execute a registered stage producer and independent verifier for each proof
findings.risk: generated rows impersonate executed mechanisms

findings.raw_evidence: producer and verifier identities are constructed strings
findings.required_correction: bind separate execution receipts and code hashes
findings.risk: identity names do not prove processes executed independently

findings.raw_evidence: status PASS follows field validation
findings.required_correction: make the proof service persist only externally produced verified receipts
findings.risk: the helper can manufacture semantic authority

findings.raw_evidence: human_authority Brad record is synthesized in repository code
findings.required_correction: consume an exact prompt-bound, actor/run/candidate/patch/path/nonce/expiry receipt
findings.risk: human authorization origin is not external

findings.raw_evidence: lifecycles consume Batch091 terminal and generated proof chains
findings.required_correction: re-run only after corrected canonical AMDS and executed proof chains
findings.risk: downstream success inherits unsupported authority

findings.raw_evidence: non-source classification consumes pre-arranged terminal evidence
findings.required_correction: execute project-level reproducers and canonical AMDS without answer keys
findings.risk: non-source terminal depth is not independently reconstructed

findings.raw_evidence: active_state and switched_state are Python dictionaries
findings.required_correction: use real isolated slots and atomic active-pointer replacement
findings.risk: no real active package-slot transition or rollback occurred

findings.raw_evidence: product-reachable lifecycle operations are not uniformly brokered
findings.required_correction: route build/install/replay/canary/rollback through the canonical broker
findings.risk: external-operation custody is incomplete

findings.raw_evidence: critic receives a compact builder-computed summary
findings.required_correction: supply raw ledgers, manifests, SQLite export, truth, and criteria
findings.risk: critic does not reconstruct conclusions from raw evidence

findings.raw_evidence: re-signed mutations alter summary fields
findings.required_correction: mutate raw bundles and consistently regenerate every affected manifest
findings.risk: semantic mutation coverage does not exercise raw evidence dependencies

findings.raw_evidence: manifest lists its own path with the empty-file SHA-256
findings.required_correction: exclude every manifest from its own hash list and reconcile the historical defect
findings.risk: the outer manifest cannot truthfully verify itself
